Posts an entry under ACC-DR01 and STD-04, through SYS-C01 (not written yet) and STD-99 (a typo), twice: SYS-C01.

The product S2 and the domains ACC and S2-OPS are named in plain prose, so they are not citations;
`ACC`, `S2` and `S2-OPS` are.

QQ-01 has no known prefix and is not a record, so it is not read. STD on its own has no "-" after the prefix.
In code it is not read: `see SYS-C99`.
